categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou SDIC Microelectronics Inc. primarily engages in the research, development, and sales of high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. Its main product lines include medical health SoC chips, industrial control and instrumentation chips, and intelligent sensing SoC chips, serving applications in medical health, pressure measurement, industrial control, instrumentation, and smart home sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on proprietary high-precision ADC-based mixed-signal SoC technology, including Sigma-Delta modulator circuits, high-performance analog signal chain circuits, and high-performance MCU technology. It employs a fabless business model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to specialized foundries and subcontractors. The company integrates advanced circuit design with software algorithms to enhance chip precision, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include medical device manufacturers, industrial equipment producers, and smart home appliance makers. The company’s chips are widely used in medical health devices such as blood glucose meters, blood pressure monitors, and infrared thermometers; industrial control instruments like digital multimeters and pressure transmitters; and intelligent sensing applications including PIR sensors and smart appliance controls.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with nearly all revenue generated from domestic sales (over 99%). It has branch offices in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Xi’an, and its subsidiary Shenzhen Chipbond Microelectronics extends its presence in Guangdong Province. Overseas sales constitute a small portion of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou SDIC Microelectronics operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to third-party foundries and subcontractors. It is positioned upstream in the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in integrated circuit design and application solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in high-precision ADC mixed-signal SoC technology, expanding product lines in medical health, industrial control, intelligent sensing, and battery management systems (BMS). It invests heavily in R&D (over 54% of revenue), focusing on new SoC chip development, algorithm integration, and application-specific solutions. Strategic acquisitions, such as the purchase of Shenzhen Chipbond Microelectronics, aim to broaden technology reserves and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuit chips, including SoC solutions tailored for specific applications. The company recognizes revenue at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with sales mainly conducted via direct sales and some distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international analog IC giants like Analog Devices (ADI) and Texas Instruments (TI), as well as domestic and regional players such as Chipsea Technology, Hycon, and Sonix. It holds a leading position in China’s high-precision ADC mixed-signal SoC niche, with recognized technology and product differentiation in medical and industrial segments, supported by multiple national and provincial innovation awards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 134.85 million, a 6.34% increase year-over-year, with chip sales volume growing 15.34%. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.27 million, the loss narrowed significantly compared to the previous year. The company maintains a strong asset base of over RMB 1.4 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, representing over 54% of revenue. It completed a major acquisition in late 2024, expanding its scale and capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hangzhou SDIC Microelectronics emphasizes high integration, precision, and cost-effectiveness in its analog and mixed-signal SoC chips. Its proprietary ADC technology and integrated software algorithms enable superior measurement accuracy and system reliability. The company offers comprehensive, customized application solutions and strong local support, providing customers with competitive, high-quality products that serve critical applications in healthcare, industrial control, and smart sensing.
